run_agent_framework: run the AgentFramework with an event bus, config, and agent instance in an async loop
create_agent_framework: create an AgentFramework instance with a control mode of TERMINAL_ONLY, LAUNCH_SERVER, or SERVER_AND_TERMINAL
reset_agent_framework: reset the AgentFramework by shutting down components and restarting without closing the event bus
register_event_subscribers: register additional event subscribers to the event bus using EventSubscriberConfig objects with event types and handlers
get_event_bus: get the event bus from an AgentFramework instance to publish or subscribe to events
